objective: Determine whether the already implemented exact UTF-8 BPE source-position action representation can reconstruct every locked acquisition and development target byte-for-byte, expose a material instruction-following copy signal, and support a generator whose parameter count is matched to the failed 14,587,728-parameter native-token control.
causal_basis: V142 showed that additional targeted records did not close fixed-action target four-gram coverage, and V144 showed that contextual native-token identities make exact native-token pointers effectively unavailable. The previously tested V54 UTF-8 BPE pointer model was only 4,174,280 parameters and used 7,000 original records. This audit asks a materially distinct representability and matched-capacity question using the combined 14,000-record acquisition set before any training is considered.

capacity_match.selection: closest absolute parameter count from the preregistered four-architecture grid

decision_rule: PASS authorizes only a separately preregistered, one-seed, matched-capacity UTF-8 span-copy training screen using the combined acquisition set. FAIL closes this exact span-copy successor. No result authorizes final-test access or a Phase 3 certificate.
claim_boundary: Exact representation and parameter accounting only. No candidate quality, runtime, LayerCake change, or Phase 3 pass is claimed.
